name: GENBA no Kizuna
source:
Sunday, September 12, 2010

When a body is found at the Kaseki Residence, once home to a world-renowned paleontologist, rookie officers Keiichi Genba, Himatsu Mizu, Rei Shirayuki and Dr. Shinketsu Kikai are tasked with investigating the scene.

Not only do they need to uncover the identity of the victim and reconstruct the events leading up to his untimely death…

...they will also need to learn how to effectively work as a team in order to do so.
